title: Thankful in the Lions' Den
scripture_text: He prayed and gave thanks before his God...
devotional:
## Key Word
**Thanksgiving is not a reaction to comfort — it is a decision in the middle of the threat.**

## Word Focus
Daniel did not wait for the den to pass before he gave thanks. He prayed while the decree was signed. Gratitude was his custom, not his mood.

A thankful heart does not deny the danger — it refuses to let the danger rename God. Thank Him in the threat, and you remember who is on the throne.

This month, let thanksgiving be your daily custom. Whether the door is open or the decree is signed, kneel, pray, and give thanks. The God who kept Daniel in the den is the same God keeping you today.

## Bible Story Tie-In — Daniel
Daniel prayed three times a day with his windows open, even after the king signed the decree. His thanksgiving did not stop when the threat started.

## Prayer
Father, teach me to thank You before the answer comes.
Amen.

## Confession
- I give thanks in every season.
- My gratitude is a decision, not a mood.
- No decree can silence my praise.
- God is faithful in the den and out of it.

## Action Point
Kneel and thank God for three things before you sleep tonight.

## Quiz
- What did Daniel do when he heard about the decree?
- Why is thanksgiving a decision and not a mood?
- What will you thank God for today, before the answer comes?

— Pastor Amos

title: Thanksgiving After the Den
scripture_text: Oh, give thanks to the LORD, for He is good!
devotional:
## Key Word
**When God shuts the lions' mouths, your thanksgiving should be louder than your fear ever was.**

## Word Focus
Daniel spent the night with the lions, and morning found him unharmed. The God who kept him in the den is the God who keeps you now.

Deliverance is not the end of the story — it is the beginning of thanksgiving. When God brings you out, praise is the right response.

This month, let your thanksgiving overflow. Count the dens you have walked out of, name the lions God silenced, and thank Him out loud. A grateful heart turns every deliverance into worship.

## Bible Story Tie-In — Daniel
The king found Daniel alive at dawn and ordered the accusers thrown in instead. The God who shut the lions' mouths turned a death sentence into a decree of praise.

## Prayer
Father, thank You for shutting the lions' mouths over my life.
Amen.

## Confession
- I am delivered, and I give thanks.
- No lion can touch what God protects.
- My praise is louder than my fear.
- God turns my den into a testimony.

## Action Point
Name three deliverances from this year and thank God for each one.

## Quiz
- Who shut the lions' mouths, according to Daniel?
- What did the king decree after Daniel came out alive?
- Which deliverance will you thank God for today?

— Pastor Amos
